metadata.measurement_harness: Original recovery harness; portable candidate not executed during authoring.
metadata.process_ms_scope: Spawn through child exit, including imports, setup of adapter seams, before/after hash inventories and JSON serialization; excludes separate fixture setup child.
metadata.command_ms_scope: Only synchronous public runCli doctor call; setup, imports, before/after inventories and serialization excluded.
metadata.counts_scope: Diagnostic attempted function/event counts, not OS syscall counts.
metadata.raw_export_scope: Every command/process latency including warmups and fresh controls; every diagnostic event grouped by build/phase/kind, observed cache results, check order and lock event timestamps. Full filesystem hash inventories and full path-rich event details are retained in original recovery data, not duplicated here.

bun_version_provenance.caller_receipt: Same explicit executable immediately afterward for the matrix; no dependency install between pilot and matrix.

metadata.summary_export_note: Grouped observed_calls are present once in each matching diagnostic result; summary keeps original raw latency arrays, medians and instrumented lock brackets.
